8 of 11 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Sustainability Report 2015 — Draft Review

The committee convened to address the urgent matter of the Sustainability Report 2015 — Draft Review. Ewan Drake provided a comprehensive overview of the situation, including its potential impact on Lochsa Consulting's operations in the Robotics & Automation sector. The committee deliberated on several response options before proceeding to a vote.

Item 2
Benefits Renewal — Carrier Selection Update

The Benefits Renewal — Carrier Selection Update was a review of the company's brand and reputation metrics. Blanche Nwosu reported a 20-point increase in brand sentiment following the recent marketing campaign.

Motion

To approve for milestones: RESOLVED, that the Partner Ecosystem Committee ratifies the actions of management with respect to the Benefits Renewal — Carrier Selection Update for the period ending 2015-04-12.

Moved: Ewan Drake  •  Seconded: Yanto Owens
Vote: 6 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  2 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Regulatory Update: Immigration Reform and Control Act (IRCA) Compliance Briefing

The committee considered the Regulatory Update: Immigration Reform and Control Act (IRCA) Compliance Briefing, a proposal to adopt a new policy on charitable contributions. The policy was approved and will be implemented company-wide.

Motion

To amend: RESOLVED, that the Partner Ecosystem Committee shall enter into executive session to discuss confidential matters.

Moved: Colette Sokolov  •  Seconded: Martha Richter
Vote: 8 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 4
HR Technology Stack Rationalization Plan

The HR Technology Stack Rationalization Plan was a review of the company's performance management process. The committee approved a move to a continuous feedback model, eliminating annual performance reviews.
